annotations.title: Company Financials Search: Norway and Denmark Annual Accounts

description: Get annual accounts figures for companies from official registers: revenue, operating profit, profit before tax, net profit, total assets, equity, cash and employees per company-year, with currency, reporting period and a link to the filing. Norway (Brønnøysund Regnskapsregisteret) and Denmark (Danish Business Authority XBRL). One schema; company level only; sole proprietorships are skipped. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

companies.description: Company registry numbers: Norwegian organisation numbers (9 digits) or Danish CVR numbers (8 digits). Prefix NO or DK to be explicit, for example NO923609016 or DK24256790.

years.description: How many of the latest reporting periods to return per company.
